name: Garlic Butter Chicken Rice
instructions: Sear chicken pieces in butter until golden. Add chopped garlic and onion, cook until fragrant. Add rice and enough water, cover and simmer 15-20 minutes until rice is tender. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Classic Tomato Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente. Saute garlic in olive oil, add chopped tomatoes and simmer into a sauce. Toss pasta in sauce, top with basil and parmesan.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble egg and set aside. Stir-fry onion, garlic, carrot and peas in oil. Add cold rice, soy sauce and scrambled egg, stir-fry until combined.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices, grill or pan-sear. Make a sauce with onion, garlic, ginger, tomato and cream. Simmer chicken in the sauce until cooked through.

name: Simple Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper. Cook in buttered pan over low heat, add cheese, fold and serve.

name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion, cumin and chili powder. Fill tortillas with beef, top with tomato, lettuce and cheese.

name: Chickpea Curry (Chana Masala)
instructions: Saute onion, garlic and ginger in oil. Add spices and tomato, cook into a thick sauce. Add chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter bread slices, place cheese between them, and grill in a pan on both sides until golden and cheese melts.

name: Shrimp Garlic Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles. Saute shrimp and garlic in butter until pink. Add soy sauce and cooked noodles, toss with chili flakes.

name: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Saute onion and celery, add chopped carrot and potato, pour in broth and simmer until vegetables are tender. Season to taste.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
instructions: Make a tomato-based sauce with butter, garlic, ginger and spices. Blend smooth, add cream and paneer cubes, simmer briefly.

name: Egg Fried Noodles
instructions: Scramble egg, set aside. Stir-fry garlic, carrot and cabbage in oil. Add noodles and soy sauce, mix in egg and toss well.

name: Baked Salmon with Lemon
instructions: Rub salmon with olive oil, garlic and herbs. Squeeze lemon over top, season with salt and pepper. Bake at 200C for 12-15 minutes.

name: Lentil Soup (Dal)
instructions: Boil lentils with turmeric until soft. In a separate pan, saute onion, garlic and cumin in oil, add tomato, then mix into the lentils and simmer.

name: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Spread tomato sauce on dough, top with mozzarella. Bake until crust is golden. Add fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil before serving.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Grill chicken and slice. Toss lettuce with caesar dressing, top with chicken, parmesan and croutons.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Stir-fry garlic in hot oil, add chopped vegetables and cook until crisp-tender. Toss with soy sauce.

name: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown beef chunks, add onion and garlic, then potato, carrot, broth and tomato paste. Simmer until meat is tender, about 1.5 hours.

name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble egg in oil, add cold rice and soy sauce, stir-fry until heated through, garnish with spring onion.

name: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Saute onion, garlic and mushroom in butter. Add rice, then gradually stir in warm broth until creamy. Finish with parmesan.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Simmer chicken with broth, onion, carrot and celery until cooked. Shred chicken, add noodles and cook until tender.

name: Falafel Wrap
instructions: Blend chickpeas with garlic and spices, form patties and fry until crisp. Wrap in tortilla with lettuce, tomato and tahini sauce.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Cook pasta. Gently fry sliced garlic in olive oil with chili flakes, toss in pasta and parsley.

name: Pork Fried Rice
instructions: Stir-fry diced pork until cooked, set aside. Scramble egg, saute garlic, carrot and peas, add rice, pork and soy sauce, combine well.

name: Vegetable Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs and season. Saute vegetables, pour eggs over, add cheese, cook until set and fold.

name: Thai Green Curry
instructions: Fry curry paste, add chicken and cook until browned. Pour in coconut milk, simmer with bell pepper, season with fish sauce and top with basil.

name: Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Saute onion with cumin, add black beans and warm through. Fill tortillas, top with tomato, cheese and a squeeze of lime.

name: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender, mash with butter and warm milk, season with salt and pepper.

name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
instructions: Mix tuna with mayonnaise, chopped celery and onion. Spread on bread with lettuce.

name: Vegetable Curry
instructions: Saute onion, garlic and ginger, add curry powder and tomato. Add potato, carrot and peas with water, simmer until vegetables are tender.

name: Beef Burger
instructions: Season and grill beef patties. Assemble in buns with cheese, lettuce, tomato and onion.

name: Shakshuka
instructions: Saute onion, bell pepper and garlic, add tomato and spices, simmer into a sauce. Crack eggs into the sauce and cook until set.

name: Chicken Quesadilla
instructions: Saute chicken with onion and bell pepper. Layer with cheese between tortillas and cook until crisp and melted.

name: Miso Soup
instructions: Heat water, whisk in miso paste. Add cubed tofu and seaweed, simmer briefly, garnish with spring onion.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Cook diced chicken, set aside. Scramble egg, saute garlic and vegetables, add rice, chicken and soy sauce, stir-fry together.

name: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice tomato and mozzarella, layer with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil and season with salt.

name: Butter Chicken
instructions: Marinate and cook chicken. Make sauce from butter, tomato, garlic, ginger and spices, add cream, then simmer chicken in sauce.

name: Vegetable Pasta Primavera
instructions: Cook pasta. Saute vegetables and garlic in olive oil, toss with pasta and top with parmesan.

name: Pulled Pork Sandwich
instructions: Slow-cook pork until tender, shred and mix with barbecue sauce. Serve on a bun topped with coleslaw.

name: Egg Curry
instructions: Boil and halve eggs. Make a sauce with onion, tomato, garlic, ginger and curry powder, add eggs and simmer briefly.

name: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop cucumber, tomato and onion, combine with olives and feta, drizzle with olive oil.

name: Chicken Stir Fry
instructions: Stir-fry chicken until cooked, remove. Stir-fry garlic and vegetables, return chicken, toss with soy sauce.

name: Baked Ziti
instructions: Cook pasta, mix with tomato sauce and ricotta. Top with mozzarella and bake until bubbly and golden.

name: Vegetable Quiche
instructions: Saute spinach and onion. Whisk eggs with milk, mix in vegetables and cheese, pour into crust and bake until set.

name: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices, grill and slice. Wrap in tortilla with lettuce and tomato.

name: Potato Leek Soup
instructions: Saute leek and onion in butter, add potato and broth, simmer until tender, blend and stir in cream.

name: Beef Chili
instructions: Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add tomato, beans and spices, simmer for 30 minutes until thickened.

name: Vegetable Fajitas
instructions: Saute sliced peppers and onion with cumin and chili powder. Serve in tortillas with a squeeze of lime.

name: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Coat chicken in egg and breadcrumbs, fry until golden. Top with tomato sauce and cheese, bake until melted.

name: Rice and Beans
instructions: Saute onion and garlic with cumin, add beans and cooked rice, stir together and heat through.

name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
instructions: Saute mushroom, onion and garlic in butter, add broth and simmer, blend smooth and stir in cream.

name: Shrimp Tacos
instructions: Season shrimp with chili powder and pan-sear. Fill tortillas with shrimp, cabbage and a lime-mayo drizzle.

name: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Cook pasta and grilled chicken. Make sauce from butter, garlic, cream and parmesan, toss with pasta and chicken.

name: Vegetable Kebabs
instructions: Toss vegetables in olive oil and garlic, skewer and grill until charred and tender.

name: Fish and Chips
instructions: Coat fish in flour and egg, fry until crisp. Fry potato wedges until golden. Serve together with salt.

name: Vegetable Biryani
instructions: Saute onion, garlic and ginger with spices, add vegetables and yogurt. Layer with partially cooked rice and steam until fully cooked.

name: Turkey Sandwich
instructions: Layer turkey, cheese, lettuce and tomato between bread slices spread with mayonnaise.

name: Coconut Chickpea Curry
instructions: Saute onion, garlic and ginger with curry powder, add tomato and coconut milk, then chickpeas, simmer 10 minutes.

name: Baked Chicken Thighs
instructions: Rub chicken thighs with olive oil, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper. Bake at 200C for 35-40 minutes until golden.

name: Vegetable Ramen
instructions: Simmer broth with soy sauce, mushroom and carrot. Cook noodles separately, add to broth, top with soft-boiled egg and spring onion.

name: Palak Paneer
instructions: Blanch and puree spinach. Saute onion, garlic and ginger, add tomato and spices, stir in spinach puree, add paneer cubes and cream, simmer briefly.

name: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Saute cumin seeds in oil, add onion and tomato, then potato and cauliflower with turmeric and coriander. Cover and cook until vegetables are tender.

name: Baingan Bharta
instructions: Roast eggplant until charred and soft, peel and mash. Saute onion, garlic, ginger and cumin, add tomato, then mashed eggplant, cook until combined.

name: Masala Dosa
instructions: Spread rice batter thin on a hot griddle to form a crepe. Fill with a spiced potato-onion mixture tempered with mustard seeds, turmeric and curry leaves. Fold and serve.

name: Idli Sambar
instructions: Steam rice batter in idli molds until fluffy. Cook lentils with tomato, tamarind and carrot into a soup, temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves, serve alongside idli.

name: Rajma (Kidney Bean Curry)
instructions: Saute onion, garlic and ginger in oil, add tomato and garam masala, then cooked kidney beans and simmer 15 minutes until thickened.

name: Malai Kofta
instructions: Mash potato and paneer, form into balls and fry until golden. Make a creamy tomato-onion sauce with garlic, ginger and garam masala, add fried koftas just before serving.

name: Vegetable Pulao
instructions: Saute whole spices and onion in oil, add mixed vegetables, then rice and water. Cover and cook until rice is fluffy and fully cooked.

name: Poha
instructions: Rinse and soften flattened rice. Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, saute onion and potato with turmeric, mix in the rice and peanuts, heat through.

name: Vegetable Upma
instructions: Roast semolina until fragrant. Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, saute onion and vegetables, add water and semolina, stir until thick and fluffy.

name: Paneer Tikka
instructions: Marinate paneer cubes in yogurt, garam masala, ginger and garlic. Skewer with bell pepper and onion, grill or bake until lightly charred.

name: Bhindi Masala (Okra Stir Fry)
instructions: Saute okra in oil until no longer sticky. Add onion, cook until soft, then tomato and spices, cook until okra is tender.

name: Kadai Paneer
instructions: Saute onion, garlic and ginger, add tomato and garam masala to form a sauce. Add bell pepper and paneer, cook until vegetables are just tender.

name: Aloo Paratha
instructions: Mash spiced potato and onion filling, stuff into wheat dough, roll flat and pan-fry with butter until golden on both sides.

name: Chole Bhature
instructions: Simmer chickpeas with a spiced onion-tomato-garlic-ginger sauce until thick. Fry rounds of leavened flour dough until puffed, serve together.

name: Vegetable Korma
instructions: Blend onion, garlic, ginger and cashews into a paste, saute until fragrant. Add coconut milk and vegetables, simmer until tender and creamy.

name: Methi Thepla
instructions: Knead wheat flour with chopped fenugreek leaves, yogurt and spices into a dough. Roll thin and pan-fry with oil until golden spots appear.

name: Gobi Manchurian
instructions: Coat cauliflower florets in flour and fry until crisp. Stir-fry garlic, bell pepper and spring onion, add soy sauce, toss in fried cauliflower to coat.

name: Pav Bhaji
instructions: Boil and mash potato, peas and bell pepper. Saute onion and tomato in butter with pav bhaji masala, mix in mashed vegetables. Toast bread rolls in butter and serve alongside.

name: Sambar
instructions: Cook lentils until soft. Add tamarind, vegetables and sambar powder, simmer until vegetables are cooked. Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Mix cooked rice, black beans, corn, tomato and cumin. Stuff into halved bell peppers, top with cheese and bake until peppers are tender.

name: Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Layer lasagna sheets with tomato sauce, sauteed zucchini and spinach, and ricotta. Top with mozzarella and bake until bubbly and golden.

name: Buddha Bowl
instructions: Arrange cooked quinoa, roasted chickpeas, sliced avocado, carrot, cucumber and spinach in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil.

name: Cauliflower Fried Rice
instructions: Pulse cauliflower into rice-sized pieces. Scramble egg, saute garlic, carrot and peas, add cauliflower rice and soy sauce, stir-fry until tender, garnish with spring onion.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Coat eggplant slices in egg and breadcrumbs, fry until golden. Layer with tomato sauce and cheeses, bake until melted and bubbly.

name: Aloo Matar (Potato Peas Sabzi)
instructions: Saute cumin seeds in oil, add onion until golden, then tomato and spices. Add potato and peas with a splash of water, cover and simmer until tender.

name: Gajar Matar (Carrot Peas Sabzi)
instructions: Saute cumin seeds and ginger in oil, add onion until soft. Add carrot and peas with turmeric, cover and cook until vegetables are tender.

name: Lauki Sabzi (Bottle Gourd Curry)
instructions: Saute cumin seeds in oil, add onion and tomato, cook until soft. Add chopped bottle gourd with turmeric and coriander, cover and simmer until tender.

name: Karela Sabzi (Bitter Gourd Stir Fry)
instructions: Saute sliced bitter gourd in oil until browned. Add onion, turmeric and coriander, cook until soft, finish with a pinch of amchur for tang.

name: Mixed Vegetable Sabzi
instructions: Saute cumin seeds in oil, add mixed chopped vegetables with turmeric and coriander. Cover and cook until all vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.

name: Dum Aloo
instructions: Fry small whole potatoes until golden. Make a yogurt-tomato based sauce with onion, garlic, ginger and garam masala, add potatoes and simmer covered until infused.

name: Aloo Methi (Potato Fenugreek Sabzi)
instructions: Saute cumin seeds in oil, add onion and diced potato with turmeric. Cover and cook until potato softens, stir in chopped fenugreek leaves and cook a few more minutes.

name: Kadhi Pakora
instructions: Whisk yogurt with chickpea flour and turmeric, simmer into a tangy sauce. Fry onion fritters (pakora) from chickpea flour batter, add to the sauce, temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

name: Cabbage Sabzi (Patta Gobi)
instructions: Temper mustard seeds and green chili in oil, add onion until soft. Add shredded cabbage and turmeric, cover and cook until just tender, keeping a slight crunch.

name: Beans Poriyal
instructions: Temper mustard seeds, urad dal and curry leaves in oil. Add chopped green beans, cover and cook until tender, finish with grated coconut.

name: Vegetable Jalfrezi
instructions: Stir-fry julienned bell pepper, onion and carrot with ginger and garlic on high heat. Add tomato and garam masala, cook briefly to keep vegetables crisp.

name: Avial (Mixed Vegetable Coconut Curry)
instructions: Cook mixed vegetables until tender. Blend coconut and cumin into a paste, stir into vegetables with yogurt, finish with curry leaves and a drizzle of coconut oil.

name: Parwal Sabzi (Pointed Gourd Curry)
instructions: Saute cumin seeds in oil, add onion and tomato until soft. Add sliced pointed gourd with turmeric and coriander, cover and cook until tender.

name: Sev Tamatar Sabzi
instructions: Saute cumin seeds in oil, add onion and tomato, cook into a soft masala. Season with turmeric and coriander, top generously with crunchy sev just before serving.

name: Tori Sabzi (Ridge Gourd Curry)
instructions: Saute cumin seeds in oil, add onion and tomato, cook until soft. Add peeled and chopped ridge gourd with turmeric, cover and simmer until tender.

name: Capsicum Aloo Sabzi
instructions: Saute cumin seeds in oil, add potato and cook until half tender. Add bell pepper and onion with turmeric and coriander, cook until vegetables are tender.

name: Undhiyu
instructions: Combine chopped winter vegetables and fenugreek leaf dumplings with a ground spice-coconut paste. Cover and slow-cook until all vegetables are tender and well infused.

name: Kootu (Vegetable Lentil Curry)
